source_snapshot.items: SP.1_SPI functional - BMC and BMC EROT
source_snapshot.procedure: Test SPI connections between BMC and BMC EROT; measure QSPI0 from BMC to CEC1736.
source_snapshot.criteria: Devices can successfully communicate over SPI.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_SPI_BMC_and_BMCEROT; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires physical scope/logic-analyzer or vendor internal EROT validation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/MEDIUM; held Pending for endpoint/probe map, SPI electrical/protocol handshake oracle, calibrated capture or equivalent diagnostic, safe probing and recovery.

old_problem: SSH inventory cannot prove activity or signal integrity on the named QSPI0 link. The source lacks board-revision probe points, bus voltage/mode/clock/chip-select and transaction/timing oracle; uncontrolled probing could load or short a security-critical BMC/EROT bus.
disposition_reason: ED-09 explicitly keeps physical hardware operations with a qualified human; physicality alone is not an Engineering Decision blocker. The review can preserve full coverage with a closed parameterized manual procedure: approved passive capture of a target-bound transaction or a documented equivalent internal diagnostic, compared only to a signed electrical/protocol oracle. Missing project values prevent execution and PASS, but not review resolution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2164, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2165 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00052-V002 / 4ab2798841def9b6 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind exact board revisions, BMC/CEC1736 identities, QSPI0 schematic/probe points and signal voltage before physical access.
Bind SPI mode, clock, chip-select, expected non-mutating transaction/handshake, timing and electrical limits; no PASS without this oracle.
Qualified operator uses calibrated high-impedance passive instrumentation, or vendor runs an internal diagnostic whose documented coverage proves the same QSPI0 link.
Evidence must include setup photos, raw waveform/decoded frames or signed raw diagnostic, endpoint logs and restored probe-free state.
No active drive, SPI write, firmware change, reset, unsafe hot probing or automatic repeat is allowed.
No probe attachment, diagnostic, firmware change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Manual BMC-to-CEC1736 QSPI0 functional and electrical validation
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate a target-bound functional SPI exchange on physical QSPI0 from the BMC to the CEC1736 BMC EROT and verify its electrical/protocol behavior against the approved oracle.
required_package: Board-revision-specific BMC/CEC1736 QSPI0 schematic and approved probe map
Signed voltage, SPI mode, clock/chip-select, handshake and timing oracle
Qualified operator and calibrated high-impedance scope/logic analyzer, or approved equivalent internal diagnostic
Maintenance/probe attach-remove procedure, BMC/EROT health monitoring and recovery
Secure raw capture and log storage
test_case.test_command: MANUAL ONLY; BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Qualified operator passively captures the approved BMC-to-CEC1736 QSPI0 transaction at the authorized points, or runs the explicitly equivalent vendor internal diagnostic. Retain raw waveform/decoded frames or signed diagnostic output and compare endpoint, chip-select, voltage, mode, clock, timing and response to the frozen oracle.
test_case.expected_result: A complete transaction is unequivocally bound to the BMC and CEC1736 on QSPI0 and meets all signed electrical, timing and handshake criteria; BMC/EROT remain healthy and the system returns to the documented probe-free state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed oracle plus complete target-bound physical or equivalent diagnostic evidence. FAIL on missing/malformed response, limit breach, wrong target, probe-induced anomaly or endpoint fault. Missing oracle/operator/instrument is runtime BLOCKED; inventory alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until probe map, electrical/protocol oracle, calibrated setup, maintenance state and recovery are signed.
Qualified operator only; use approved high-impedance passive points and grounding.
Never drive QSPI0, issue writes, alter firmware, reset endpoints or auto-repeat.
Stop on unsafe access, abnormal voltage/timing, ambiguous chip-select, communication loss or BMC/EROT fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval, board revisions and endpoint identities
Probe map, instrument serial/calibration/settings and setup photos, or diagnostic version/hash/coverage
Complete raw waveform and decoded chip-select/clock/data frames, or signed equivalent output
Electrical/timing/handshake comparison against the signed oracle
Pre/post BMC/EROT console/SEL/log health and restored probe-free state
test_case.recovery: Stop capture/diagnostic on unsafe probing or endpoint fault, preserve all raw evidence, and remove probes only through the approved procedure. Restore the known-good BMC/EROT state using the signed recovery; do not write firmware or force a reset to create a pass.
